name: finance__quote
description: Current stock price. Use when asked for a company's share price. Not for used or product prices, bare numbers, exchange rates (use finance__fx) or company news (use search__web). When asked why it moved, call search__web too.

krw.description: true to show it in Korean won

symbol.description: Ticker (e.g. AAPL, 005930.KS). If unsure, find it with search__web first.

name: places__search
description: Find places and shops on Kakao Map (name, address, phone, map link). Use to find restaurants, cafes, shops or places. If the area is unknown, do not use it and finish: the reply step asks where. Places outside Korea: search__web.

query.description: Area + kind only, no adjectives (e.g. Gangnam station lunch, Hongdae cafe)

name: polls__create
description: Creates a Discord poll. Use when someone clearly asks for a poll. Not when someone only asks for opinions.

options_text.description: The choices, one per line (2–10, up to 55 characters each). Empty = Yes/No.

name: search__web
description: Web search (news, latest information, fact checks). Use for search requests, today's or recent news, who holds a post now, facts that change (rankings, prices, results), or when another tool failed. Also for used prices and what an item costs now. For news and current affairs, give topic=news. Give depth=deep for summaries, comparisons and other questions with several sides, or when asked to look in detail or look further. Not for word meanings, common knowledge, arithmetic, translation or small talk.

depth.description: How hard to search. Usually leave out (standard: also reads the main pages), also for a light one-thing question like 'why did it go up?' or 'what is that?'. quick: one fact checked fast (a date, a price, who, a score). deep: summaries and comparisons, 'why' or 'how did it happen' questions with several sides, research-like questions, requests such as 'in detail', 'look further' or 'dig deeper', and a follow-up saying the last answer was thin.

fresh.description: day, week or month when only recent pages will do

queries.description: Only with deep: 1–3 more search queries that ask the same question from other angles (in the language of query). Otherwise leave out.

query.description: Search words: key terms only, in the message's language.

topic.description: news: when looking for news articles or current affairs (usually with fresh). Otherwise leave out

name: weather__query
description: Weather for any city worldwide, today up to 13 days ahead. Use for the weather or questions that depend on it (umbrella, what to wear). Not for climate or seasons as general knowledge, or warnings and earthquakes (use disasters__query).

day_offset.description: 0 today, 1 tomorrow, 2 the day after … 13. Read weekdays from the day_offset list of the reference time. For a weekend, call once for Saturday and once for Sunday.

region.description: City name, any country, from the message or the conversation. Leave it out when none is given: the tool uses the person's setting or a default and says so.

name: web__read
description: Reads the page behind a link (URL). Use when the message has a link and asks about it (summarize this, what does it say). Not when the message has no link.

max_chars.description: How much to read (usually leave out)

url.description: The http address exactly as written in the message
